description: This file defines utility template functions for type-safe sign and comparison operations, including checks for negativity, signum, and boundary comparisons, within the c10 namespace for use in the PyTorch project.

methods.name: is_negative
methods.description: Checks if a value is negative, specialized for unsigned types to always return false.

methods.name: signum
methods.description: Returns the sign of a value as -1, 0, or 1, with overloads for unsigned and signed types.

methods.name: signs_differ
methods.description: Checks if two values have different signs.

methods.name: greater_than_max
methods.description: Checks if a value exceeds the maximum of a specified limit type, considering potential overflow.

methods.name: less_than_lowest
methods.description: Checks if a value is less than the lowest of a specified limit type, with special handling for unsigned types.
